thread:
marta.k: Heads up — the 7-day telemetry backfill for agg_hours is stalling at ~40% on prod. Job runner shows repeated 'partition mismatch' retries.
kevin.t: ugh. saw some of those logs this morning. stacktrace looks like: `org.redwood.backfill.PartitionLookupException: expected shard-3 but got shard-7` then the worker requeues.
indra: that smells like the partitioning function changed last week when we landed the 'hashed-namespace' routing. Did we forget to include compatibility logic in recompute?
park: yes, the new router switches namespace -> hashed(namespace)+suffix, recompute still queries old manifests. Backfill uses manifest keys from s3://telemetry/manifests/yyyy/mm/dd, but the keys now include `-v2` suffix.
marta.k: options: (1) add compat layer to recompute (cheap but risky), (2) regenerate manifests before running backfill (expensive), (3) make a coordinator that maps old->new keys on the fly and throttles concurrency.
kevin.t: option 3 sounds safest. We can implement a lightweight coordinator that reads a span of manifests, translates keys, enqueues canonically, and tracks checkpoints in Redis. That also lets us quota the backfill traffic to avoid blowing through Dedicated capacity.
indra: agreed. two more asks: add a circuit-breaker if requeue rate > 20% for 5m, and surface progress in console (backfill_pct per-job). Otherwise ops can't tell if it's actually making progress.
park: can do. quick sketch of coordinator behavior:
```
for manifest in manifests(day_range):
  mapped = translate_keys(manifest)
  for key in mapped:
    enqueue_with_bucket(key, priority=low)
    checkpoint(manifest_id)
```
Also use token-bucket per-gpu-pool to pace.
```
rbac note: coordinator needs read access to both manifests and model-run queue.
```
kevin.t: for checkpoint store, Redis hash `backfill:job:<id>:checkpoint` with last_manifest_id and processed_count. If jobs crash, resume from hash.
sasha: can we reuse existing replay-queue? I worry about introducing a new queue type. Maybe put backfill items on `recompute-low` queue and let existing workers consume, but workers need to run translate_keys step first or they'll fail.
indra: coordinator can translate before enqueueing into recompute-low, so workers remain unchanged. That keeps worker code stable.
marta.k: deployment plan: 1) feature branch for translate mapping + checkpointing, 2) deploy coordinator to staging and run a 1-day backfill, 3) add console metric `backfill.job.%id%.progress` and a small UI row in Debug -> Backfills, 4) run production canary with a single shard and 1 GPU pool, 5) ramp to full.
kevin.t: add quota buckets: `backfill:low`, `backfill:burst` with monthly caps and per-minute windows. Coordinator enforces token-bucket and honors `route-policy:low-cost` so we prefer cheaper model variants for recompute.
park: I'll prepare a minimal Grafana panel for `backfill:job:%id%:progress` and an alert if job stalls > 30m.
sasha: also add audit events to event-log: `backfill.job.started`, `.checkpoint`, `.completed` with manifest ranges — helps SRE and CS.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: `coordinator/v1` -> staging. CI: 12 checks.
kevin.t: who owns the prod rollout step? suggest @marta.k as owner, @indra as backup, and @park for dashboard + alerts.
marta.k: fine. I'll open a PR with the coordinator skeleton and a small runbook entry (backfill failure -> rollback to pause coordinator & requeue raw manifests).
indra: one more thought — add a small dedupe pass in coordinator to avoid duplicate keys across overlapping manifests. cheap bloom filter per-job should work.
kevin.t: yep. keep the filter memory-bound (2-4MB).
park: timeline? can have staging coordinator + dashboard by EOD tomorrow, prod canary Thursday.
marta.k: great. action items: @park dashboard + alert, @kevin impl checkpointing + token-bucket, @indra add circuit-breaker + dedupe bloom, @sasha event/audit hooks, @marta.k PR + rollout owner. I'll post status updates in #eng-platform. :thumbsup:
